preparation.evidence: g490 attempts 10/12 used very young candidates, joined construction 84.177/57.162ms and then waited 102.480/96.001ms for native readiness. Exact retired candidate timestamps are unavailable.
preparation.confirmedCodeDefect: A fresh hint destroyed a still-usable candidate once its remaining lifetime fell below 750ms, putting retirement/construction on an immediate entry path.
preparation.change: Retain the candidate until actual 3s expiry; leave its fixed timer, cleanup fencing and maximum process count unchanged.
preparation.regression: At age 2.4s a hint followed by entry performs zero replacement builds and zero builder join wait. Truly expired candidates still replace.

input.interpretation: Parent apply includes IPC, child authorization/desktop work and native call. The residual is not a direct measurement of scheduler or network time.
input.change: Reuse a process-local serialized IPC execution owner and response slot rather than spawning and allocating both on every command.

benchmark.scope: Synthetic IPC execution bridge, excluding native I/O and common context/deadline work
benchmark.interpretation: Allocation reduction is measured; this microbenchmark is slower by 362ns/op. No claim that the observed 106ms stall has been resolved.

writeTimeout.interpretation: A has a multi-second runtime observation gap and a GC/STW bucket of at least 1s. B reports remote EOF on the same connection. Host scheduling/GC delay is implicated; this is not evidence of pure network latency, nor exact proof of which native call delayed GC.
writeTimeout.confirmedCodeDefect: A context could expire during deadline setup/encoding, then still enter TLS Write and irreversibly poison an untouched stream.
writeTimeout.change: Final zero-byte admission check after encoding and before first TLS Write; cleanup joins cancellation and clears deadline. Actual TLS write failure remains fatal.
writeTimeout.regression: Old source fails the delayed-deadline TLS test with phase io; patched source reports admission and the next heartbeat succeeds without an expired frame.

remaining: True expired/cold preparation still needs native startup.
